description: The bonded floor: aisle after aisle of shrink-wrapped pallets under customs seals, a caged clerk's office in one corner, your breath misting in the cold sodium light. Whatever a corp holds here, the city officially cannot see.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that is more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: Bonded & Bothered
